title: I built a first-person hockey rink management sim with AI, 2,800 plays later, here’s what I’ve learned
author: jakeboyles2010
selftext:
**I built a hockey rink simulator with AI and people are actually playing it**

I've been building a browser game called Rink Life where you basically run a hockey rink.

You drive the Zamboni, sharpen skates, work concessions, move nets, clean locker rooms, ref games, schedule ice time, manage the money, and slowly upgrade the rink.

It's a pretty dumb idea on paper lol, but that's kind of why I wanted to build it.

I've been doing a lot of experimenting with AI and game development and I think one of the coolest things about it is being able to build really specific games like this. I probably would have never spent months building a hockey rink simulator from scratch, but with AI I could get the idea playable pretty quickly and then just keep adding to it.

It's now been played around 2,800 times, which I definitely didn't expect.

I've also been building VYRLD, which is the platform it runs on. The idea is that eventually anyone can type out the game they want to make and within 15 minutes or so have something they can actually play with their friends in the browser. No downloads or installs.

Still a ton to figure out, especially around getting AI generated games to feel less generic and more like actual games people want to keep playing.

Curious what you guys think of this direction and what you would change about Rink Life.

[https://vyrld.com/w/rink-life](https://vyrld.com/w/rink-life)
